title: Detecting Photoactivatable Cre-mediated Gene Deletion Efficiency in Escherichia coli
author: Yuta Koganezawa

Aluminum foil E. coli strain, carrying a fluorescently tagged target gene flanked with two loxP sequences and photoactivatable Cre (PA-Cre) system. Here, we used YK0083, which has a chloramphenicol resistance gene, cat , as a target gene for demonstration. The mCherry-tagged cat gene sandwiched with two loxP sequences was introduced into the intC locus on the genome. The genes for the PA-Cre system, creN-nmag and pmag-creC, are placed downstream of P LlacO1 promoter on a plasmid. These genes are inducible by IPTG. steps.title: Grow overnight LB culture
steps.instruction: Inoculate E. coli strain YK0083 into LB broth containing 50 µg/mL ampicillin and incubate at 37 °C with shaking overnight.

steps.title: Harvest cells and resuspend in M9
steps.instruction: Transfer 100 µL of the overnight culture to a microcentrifuge tube, centrifuge at 21,500 × g for 1 min at room temperature, discard the supernatant, and resuspend the pellet in 1 mL M9 medium with 0.2 % glucose and amino acids.

steps.title: Adjust OD and pre‑induction incubation
steps.instruction: Measure the OD₆₀₀ of the resuspended cells. Dilute or concentrate the suspension in 2 mL M9 medium (0.2 % glucose, amino acids) containing 50 µg/mL ampicillin and 0.1 mM IPTG to reach an OD₆₀₀ of 0.001. Cover the tube with aluminum foil and incubate at 37 °C with shaking for 3 h.

steps.title: Expose culture to blue light
steps.instruction: Remove the aluminum foil and expose the tube to blue light from a blue‑light illuminator set to 6.8 mW (λ = 470 nm) for the desired duration (see notes).

steps.title: Dilute culture to target OD
steps.instruction: Dilute the illuminated culture to an OD₆₀₀ of 1.0 × 10⁻⁶ (≈7 × 10² cells/mL).

steps.title: Plate diluted culture on Amp plates
steps.instruction: Spread 150 µL of the diluted culture onto an LB agar plate containing 100 µg/mL ampicillin and cover the plate with aluminum foil.

steps.title: Incubate plates at 37 °C
steps.instruction: Incubate the plated agar at 37 °C for 18 h.

steps.title: Count colonies and calculate deletion fraction
steps.instruction: Count total colonies under ambient light and identify non‑fluorescent colonies using excitation light on a stereomicroscope. Calculate the fraction of gene‑deleted cells as (non‑fluorescent colonies) / (total colonies).

steps.title: Prepare LB broth
steps.instruction: Dissolve 25 g Difco LB broth (Miller) in 1 L Elix® water, autoclave at 121 °C for 15 min, store at room temperature. Add 50 mg/mL ampicillin (from stock) on a clean bench just before use if required.

steps.title: Prepare LB agar with ampicillin
steps.instruction: Dissolve 25 g Difco LB broth and 15 g agar in 1 L Elix® water, autoclave at 121 °C for 15 min, cool to ~55 °C, add 2 mL of 50 mg/mL ampicillin stock on a clean bench, dispense 25 mL into each 90 mm petri dish, store at 4 °C.

steps.title: Prepare M9 medium with glucose and amino acids
steps.instruction: a) Make 5× M9 stock: dissolve 56.4 g M9 minimal salts in 1 L Milli‑Q water, autoclave 121 °C 15 min, store at room temperature. b) Prepare 20 % glucose: dissolve 10 g D‑(+)-glucose in 50 mL Milli‑Q water, filter‑sterilize (0.2 µm), store 4 °C. c) Prepare 1 M MgSO₄·7H₂O: dissolve 12.3 g in 50 mL water, filter‑sterilize, store 4 °C. d) Prepare 1 M CaCl₂·2H₂O: dissolve 7.4 g in 50 mL water, filter‑sterilize, store 4 °C. e) On a clean bench, mix 200 mL 5× M9, 10 mL 20 % glucose, 10 mL MEM amino acids solution (50×), 2 mL 1 M MgSO₄, 100 µL 1 M CaCl₂, and 778 mL sterilized water. Store at 4 °C. Add antibiotics or IPTG on the bench before use if needed.

steps.title: Prepare 1 M IPTG stock
steps.instruction: Dissolve 2.383 g IPTG in 10 mL Milli‑Q water, filter‑sterilize (0.2 µm), aliquot into microtubes, store at –20 °C.

steps.title: Prepare 50 mg/mL ampicillin stock
steps.instruction: Dissolve 500 mg ampicillin sodium in 10 mL Milli‑Q water, filter‑sterilize (0.2 µm), aliquot into microtubes, store at –20 °C.
